body.label: Trigger
body.html: You are targeted by an Action that requires line of sight.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Gain +1 Defense against the triggering Action. If you are in a Mimic Adaptation, gain +2 Defense instead.

surges.html: Increase the Defense bonus from this Reaction by 1 against a creature you can perceive.
If the triggering Action fails, move 1 unit.
